finalText:
**The build works now.** One real error, in `src/core/settings.js`.

The line read `maxRetries: retries`, but nothing named `retries` existed there. Node threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`, which killed the link step. I changed it to read `env.retries` and added a `maxRetries: 2` fallback to `DEFAULTS`.

Build finishes with 0 errors, exit 0.

The 3 warnings are still there and none of them break anything:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| `W2213` unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| `W3307` circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Only `W1042` looks worth doing soon. Say the word and I'll take it.
